description:

We are looking for an iOS Developer with Advaced English level to join our team!


Candidate responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain high-quality iOS applications using Swift

* Build and customize user interfaces, including development of reusable UI components and custom controls

* Collaborate with backend teams to integrate client-side applications with RESTful APIs and web services

* Ensure application performance, quality, and responsiveness across different devices and iOS versions

* Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to scalable and maintainable software design

* Analyze and optimize networking layer, ensuring efficient data handling and communication with servers

title: Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce (Sales & Service Cloud)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.


Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?

Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas.
  • Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações).
  • Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico.
  • Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud.
  • Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade.
  • Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema.
  • Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio.
  • Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas , CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs).
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos.
  • Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas.
  • Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant.
  • Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards).
  • Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware).
  • Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM.
  • Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce.
  • Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade.
  • Mostrar proatividade na gestão de mudanças e no treinamento de novos usuários (produção de materiais e workshops).


Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Duotalk

A Duotalk é uma plataforma omnichannel com inteligência artificial que transforma o atendimento em conversas eficientes, escaláveis e orientadas a resultado.

Estamos construindo um produto complexo, com alta integração e impacto direto no negócio dos clientes e precisamos de pessoas que garantam qualidade real na entrega, não só organização.


Missão do cargo

Garantir que estamos construindo certo o produto, com clareza, qualidade e zero ambiguidade, atuando desde a definição até a validação final das entregas.

Você será responsável por transformar estratégia em entrega funcional, testada e confiável.


Atividades:

  • Gerenciar o backlog de produtos ou de squads complexas, atuando como um especialista.
  • Colaborar diretamente com o Product Manager na definição e refinamento da estratégia de produto.
  • Definir e comunicar as prioridades estratégicas para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Liderar as cerimônias ágeis, garantindo que o time esteja sempre alinhado e produtivo.
  • Mentorar outros Product Owners e analistas em técnicas de gestão de backlog.
  • Conduzir o refinamento de requisitos complexos, desdobrando a visão do produto em entregas incrementais.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para dúvidas e decisões sobre o escopo do produto.
  • Acompanhar de perto as métricas de produto para validar o impacto das entregas e propor otimizações.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas junnto com o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar testes funcionais das entregas antes de produção.
  • Validar fluxos completos (não só partes isoladas).
  • Trabalhar junto com devs na validação do que foi desenvolvido.
  • Identificar inconsistências, edge cases e falhas de lógica.
  • Garantir que os critérios de aceite foram de fato atendidos.
  • Atuar como último gate de qualidade antes do release.


Hard Skills:

  • Expertise em Metodologias Ágeis e Escala: SAFe, LeSS ou outros frameworks (diferencial).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas de Gestão de Produtos: Jira, Confluence, Productboard (uso avançado).
  • Conhecimento Aprofundado em UX Research e Análise de Dados de Produto: Para embasar decisões.
  • Habilidade de prototipação (Diferencial): Para agilizar o alinhamento de ideias.
  • Noções de Arquitetura de Software: Para entender os impactos das decisões no desenvolvimento.


Soft Skills:

  • Visão Estratégica e de Negócios: Consegue conectar cada item do backlog à estratégia maior da Duotalk.
  • Liderança (sem ser gerente): Guia o time de desenvolvimento, influenciando e inspirando.
  • Habilidade de Negociação Avançada: Para balancear as necessidades de diferentes stakeholders.
  • Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Aborda dilemas de priorização e escopo com maestria.
  • Capacidade Analítica Avançada: Para usar dados e tomar decisões sobre o backlog.
  • Proatividade para Inovação: Busca novas formas de entregar valor e otimizar processos


O que oferecemos:

  • Contratação PJ;
  • 100% remoto;
  • Possibilidade de crescimento;
  • Gympass
  • Conexa Saúde
  • Optum Consultoria
  • Alura Educação

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Trainer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NIIT


At NIIT, we’re transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That’s why the world’s best-run learning functions across 30 countries trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high-impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.


Link to our Page -

Link for our website :


Job Title: Databricks Trainer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Job Type: Contract/Full Time

Industry: IT Training / Data & Analytics / Education Services


About the Role

We are seeking a skilled and passionate Databricks Trainer to deliver high-quality training sessions to professionals and enterprise clients in Brazil. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and data engineering and data science workflows.


Key Responsibilities


  • Deliver virtual training programs on Databricks , Spark, and related technologies.
  • Customise course content to suit client-specific needs and industry use cases.
  • Conduct workshops, hands-on labs, and Q&A sessions.
  • Support learners in building foundational and advanced data engineering and data science knowledge using Databricks.
  • Stay updated with the latest Databricks releases, features, and best practices.
  • Provide feedback to the curriculum development team to enhance course content.
  • Support pre-sales efforts by conducting demo sessions or webinars when required.


Required Qualifications


  • Proven experience as a trainer, instructor, or educator in data analytics, engineering, or cloud technologies.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks , Apache Spark , and PySpark .
  • Strong knowledge of data engineering , SQL , Python , and big data tools .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure , AWS , or GCP is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience in delivering technical training to adult learners or corporate clients.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Databricks or Spark certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate).
  • Experience in teaching or mentoring in a technical environment.
  • Ability to create training materials and lab exercises.


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.


Thanks & Regards

GS Team, NIIT

title: Tech Lead SAP FI SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead SAP FI SR em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Tech Lead SAP FI – S/4HANA

Data de Início: Imediata

Tempo de Alocação: 1 ano

Local de Trabalho: Brasil

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto - PJ

Horário de Trabalho: Comercial



Visão Geral da Posição:

Buscamos Tech Lead SAP FI para atuar em projetos estratégicos envolvendo SAP S/4HANA Finance, sendo referência técnica na definição de soluções, integrações e evolução da arquitetura financeira SAP.

O profissional terá papel chave na liderança técnica das iniciativas, apoiando múltiplos times, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e alinhamento às melhores práticas SAP, além de atuar em iniciativas de inovação e evolução contínua.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Atuar como referência técnica nas frentes SAP FI e S/4HANA Finance, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e evolução das soluções financeiras.

Liderar tecnicamente integrações entre SAP e sistemas externos, utilizando BTP, APIs, CPI, IDocs e demais tecnologias de integração.

Atuar na resolução de problemas complexos relacionados a performance, fechamento financeiro, integrações e troubleshooting técnico.

Traduzir demandas de stakeholders em soluções escaláveis e aderentes às necessidades do negócio.

Conduzir mentoria técnica e apoiar o desenvolvimento dos times, garantindo alinhamento técnico e qualidade das entregas.

Atuar com foco em dados, performance e melhoria contínua das soluções SAP.

description:

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

You will work deep in complex backend systems and will be their go-to person for everything data-related: ingestion, modeling, pipelines, and the infrastructure that keeps it all running.   • Design and build robust data ingestion pipelines to onboard, normalize, and continuously update third-party data sources that power our platform
  • Own data modeling and schema design across our platform, ensuring our data layer is structured for performance, flexibility, and long-term scale
  • Implement asynchronous and distributed processing to handle large-scale operations reliably and efficiently
  • Own data infrastructure tooling - including pipeline orchestration, storage, and warehousing - alongside application-layer development
  • Contribute to new product capabilities and integrations, working closely with other developers, AI engineers and data scientists
  • Collaborate directly with the CTO to define data strategy and technical architecture as the platform scales


What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex backend systems in production environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python and Django (or a comparable framework)
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building data ingestion pipelines and ETL workflows
  • Deep understanding of data modeling and database schema design for both relational and non-relational systems
  • Hands-on experience with data infrastructure tooling, including orchestration, storage, and warehousing
  • Solid command of asynchronous programming and distributed systems concepts
  • Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs
  • Comfort operating in small, fast-moving teams with limited oversight
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset


Bonus points for:

  • Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Previous work supporting ML, AI, or agentic systems
  • Experience with the Django REST framework
  • Understanding of Terraform or cloud infrastructure as code
  • Experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, or regulated data environments


Benefits:

  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing company at a pivotal stage, shaping scalable data-driven systems and architecture.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Java Backend Engineer / Service Engineer
description:

Senior Java Backend Engineer / Service Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Java Backend Engineer to join a global technology team and work on the development, enhancement, and support of scalable back-end services and APIs.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, relational databases, CI/CD, and production-grade service development . The professional will collaborate with global teams and interact with front-end/full-stack teams to ensure proper integration between back-end services and UI layers.

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain back-end services and APIs using Java and modern frameworks.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in enterprise applications.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and CI/CD processes.
  • Work with global teams in English.

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Java back-end development .
  • Strong experience with Java 8+ , preferably Java 17 .
  • Solid experience with Spring Framework / Spring Boot .
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs .
  • Good understanding of object-oriented programming and clean code principles .
  • Experience with microservices and distributed applications.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar .
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance services.
  • Good understanding of authorization concepts .
  • Advanced English for communication with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Practical experience with JavaScript for application integration or light front-end enhancements.
  • Experience in enterprise or financial services environments.
  • Experience with production support, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and application evolution.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Senior Java Engineer with strong back-end experience, good problem-solving skills, and the ability to work in complex enterprise environments. This is not an architect role; we are looking for someone who enjoys coding, improving services, solving technical issues, and contributing to high-quality software delivery.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements such as Spanish).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

4. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

5. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

6. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

7. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.



Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, creator management, or media production.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows .
  • Proven experience working with creators, voice artists, or creative production teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.


The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.


Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Backend Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Backend Data Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a strong Backend Engineer who thrives in fast-moving environments and has a specialty in all things data. They are at an inflection point. Their product is live and working, customers are telling them what they need, and the engineering team is building rapidly.


You will work deep in complex backend systems and will be their go-to person for everything data-related: ingestion, modeling, pipelines, and the infrastructure that keeps it all running. This is not a data-first role that happens to touch the backend; it is a backend role where data mastery is your distinguishing edge.


What you'll do:

  • Design, build, optimize and maintain scalable features and systems across our Python/Django backend
  • Design and build robust data ingestion pipelines to onboard, normalize, and continuously update third-party data sources that power our platform
  • Own data modeling and schema design across our platform, ensuring our data layer is structured for performance, flexibility, and long-term scale
  • Implement asynchronous and distributed processing to handle large-scale operations reliably and efficiently
  • Own data infrastructure tooling - including pipeline orchestration, storage, and warehousing - alongside application-layer development
  • Contribute to new product capabilities and integrations, working closely with other developers, AI engineers and data scientists
  • Collaborate directly with the CTO to define data strategy and technical architecture as the platform scales


What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex backend systems in production environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python and Django (or a comparable framework)
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building data ingestion pipelines and ETL workflows
  • Deep understanding of data modeling and database schema design for both relational and non-relational systems
  • Hands-on experience with data infrastructure tooling, including orchestration, storage, and warehousing
  • Solid command of asynchronous programming and distributed systems concepts
  • Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs
  • Comfort operating in small, fast-moving teams with limited oversight
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset


Bonus points for:

  • Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Previous work supporting ML, AI, or agentic systems
  • Experience with the Django REST framework
  • Understanding of Terraform or cloud infrastructure as code
  • Experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, or regulated data environments


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing company at a pivotal stage, shaping scalable data-driven systems and architecture.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead Java em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Tech Lead Java

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como principal referência técnica de TI para o time e para o cliente, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade das entregas, a evolução técnica da equipe e um ambiente colaborativo alinhado à cultura. Além disso, terá um papel ativo na gestão das entregas, acompanhando o andamento das atividades, identificando riscos e garantindo que os compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos com qualidade. Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar objetivos do time e assegurar a execução dos processos internos;
  • Acompanhar dinâmicas de equipes ágeis, facilitando a comunicação e desbloqueando obstáculos;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na criação de cronogramas e estimativas;
  • Realizar entrevistas técnica para novos membros e definir perfis necessários junto à coordenação;
  • Assegurar que as ferramentas de trabalho (JIRA, documentação) estejam atualizadas;
  • Resolver conflitos e manter um ambiente colaborativo, positivo e focado em resultados.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java , com atuação consistente em ambientes de produção e entendimento do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (do desenho à sustentação);
  • Domínio de Spring Boot , incluindo construção de APIs, segurança, persistência de dados e organização de aplicações escaláveis e de fácil manutenção;
  • Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, com capacidade de modelagem, escrita de queries eficientes e entendimento de performance e uso adequado de cada tecnologia;
  • Vivência com AWS , compreendendo o uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda no contexto de aplicações reais, incluindo deploy, configuração e monitoramento básico;
  • Experiência com containers (Docker e/ou Kubernetes ), entendendo o ciclo de vida das aplicações e sua execução em ambientes containerizados;
  • Experiência na construção e integração de APIs RESTful , seguindo boas práticas de design, versionamento e segurança;
  • Familiaridade com controle de versão utilizando Git, incluindo colaboração em equipe, code review e organização de branches;
  • Experiência com testes unitários, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código entregue;
  • Vivência atuando como referência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe;
  • Capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Tiver vivência com desenvolvimento de arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis;
  • Tiver conhecimento em ferramentas de busca e monitoramento, como ElasticSearch.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst with strong experience in FIX Protocol and trading applications to support technology initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, application development teams and vendors to gather, analyze, document and validate business and technical requirements for trading-related systems.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with SQL queries, UNIX log analysis, functional specifications, data flows, system integrations and UAT support .

Key responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze and document business, functional and technical requirements for trading applications.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, developers, vendors and product teams to define and validate technology solutions.
  • Create and maintain functional specifications, business rules, exception rules and process documentation.
  • Analyze system data across multiple platforms, including UNIX, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server and mainframe environments .
  • Perform SQL queries and UNIX log analysis to support requirements definition, issue investigation and validation.
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for development teams.
  • Support data sourcing activities, validating data completeness from acquisition through report or system delivery.
  • Define and support testing requirements, test cases and UAT activities.
  • Conduct functional walkthroughs and obtain business sign-off.
  • Track project risks, defects, change requests and delivery status.
  • Support multiple projects or workstreams in parallel within the software development lifecycle.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst .
  • Strong experience with FIX Protocol .
  • Experience working with trading applications or capital markets platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL queries .
  • Experience with UNIX log analysis .
  • Ability to write clear functional and technical requirements.
  • Experience creating FSDs , business requirements, test cases and UAT documentation.
  • Good understanding of system integrations, data flows and application troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams.
  • Experience working with developers, vendors, product managers and business SMEs.
  • Advanced English for communication with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, brokerage, investment banking, wealth management or capital markets.
  • Knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server or mainframe environments.
  • Experience with data governance standards.
  • Experience leading small projects or coordinating workstreams.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is not a purely functional BA. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Business Analyst who understands trading systems, can analyze FIX messages, read UNIX logs, write SQL queries, document requirements clearly and work directly with both business and technology teams.

We are seeking a Senior Advanced Analyst to join our global Advanced Analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Support Analyst L2 - Bilingual
description:

Job Description

Please submit resumes in English. Strong English speaking and writing communication skills are required.


As a Support Analyst L2, you will troubleshoot operational issues with the Warehouse Management System (WMS), manage configurations, support cloud solutions, monitor SQL performance, and maintain documentation. You bring expertise with Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle Databases, cloud services, Linux systems, supply chain technologies, and various hardware/software tools used in warehouse and distribution operations.

  • Advantage: Experience in software development.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services (AWS, Azure, OCI, Google Cloud).
  • Advantage: Experience with supply chain, distribution, and interface technologies.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) full stack
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor (a) full stack em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Hub4Pay é uma fintech brasileira especializada em soluções de pagamentos, incentivos e recompensas, criada para conectar empresas e pessoas por meio de tecnologia, eficiência e experiências relevantes. Atuamos em um mercado dinâmico e em constante transformação, onde inovação não é diferencial, é ponto de partida.


Acreditamos que tecnologia de ponta nasce de times que combinam excelência técnica, autonomia e propósito. Por isso, construímos um ambiente onde cada pessoa tem espaço para experimentar, errar com responsabilidade, aprender rápido e gerar impacto real, tanto no produto quanto na vida de quem usa nossas soluções.


Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para integrar nosso time de tecnologia e atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações web modernas, escaláveis e de alto desempenho, com forte foco em soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial (IA) . 


Nosso stack principal inclui NestJS no back-end e React no front-end , e buscamos alguém que tenha experiência e paixão por construir produtos robustos, eficientes e inteligentes, utilizando IA para otimizar processos, criar automações e desenvolver funcionalidades inovadoras.


Se você gosta de desafios , curte boas práticas de desenvolvimento, tem interesse em tecnologias de IA e quer trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, essa vaga é para você!


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Experiência com ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento, como Cursor, Replit, Lovable, GitHub Copilot, agentes de código ou automações por prompt.
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações com Node.js, NestJS, React.js e TypeScript;
  • Criar, evoluir e documentar APIs RESTful;
  • Participar de decisões de arquitetura e desenho técnico de features;
  • Revisar PRs, orientar boas práticas e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time;
  • Apoiar a especialização dos demais desenvolvedores por meio de troca de conhecimento, revisão técnica e mentoria;
  • Manter a documentação técnica atualizada;
  • Atuar diretamente com o time de suporte na investigação e resolução de bugs, discoveries e melhorias;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Implementar testes unitários e de integração;
  • Atuar com sistemas de caching, microsserviços, workers e processamento assíncrono;

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in retail.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Psiquiatra em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. VAGA PARA MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA — ATENDIMENTO ONLINE

A Dr Psiq está em expansão e busca médicos(as) psiquiatras comprometidos(as), éticos(as) e responsáveis para atuação em telemedicina, realizando atendimentos psiquiátricos por vídeo em nossa plataforma digital.

Buscamos profissionais que compreendam que a psiquiatria vai além da capacidade técnica: valorizamos médicos humanizados, pontuais, comprometidos com seus pacientes e responsáveis com os horários e agendas disponibilizados.

Principais atividades
  • Realização de consultas psiquiátricas por vídeo;
  • Avaliação diagnóstica e acompanhamento terapêutico;
  • Elaboração de planos terapêuticos individualizados;
  • Atendimento de adolescentes, adultos e idosos;
  • Evolução em prontuário eletrônico;
  • Emissão e assinatura digital de documentos médicos;
  • Participação no cuidado contínuo e promoção da saúde mental dos pacientes.
Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Graduação em Medicina;
  • CRM ativo e regular;
  • Formação em Psiquiatria através de:
  • Residência Médica com RQE ativo; ou
  • Pós-graduação em Psiquiatria reconhecida;
  • Experiência em atendimento psiquiátrico;
  • Boa comunicação e postura ética;
  • Comprometimento com agendas e horários disponibilizados para atendimento;
  • Possuir certificado digital válido (e-CPF ou equivalente) para inserção na plataforma e assinatura eletrônica de documentos médicos.
Documentação obrigatória

O profissional deverá apresentar:

  • Currículo atualizado;
  • Documento de identificação profissional;
  • CRM ativo;
  • Certidão de regularidade do Conselho Regional de Medicina;
  • Comprovante de quitação da anuidade do CRM;
  • Certidão ético-profissional emitida pelo CRM;
  • Documentação comprobatória da especialização em Psiquiatria;
  • RQE (quando aplicável);
  • Certificado digital válido para utilização na plataforma.
Processo seletivo

Após análise curricular e documental, o profissional passará por entrevista de habilitação junto à equipe da clínica para avaliação do perfil profissional, disponibilidade e alinhamento com o modelo de atendimento da instituição.

Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail:

Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do WhatsApp:

informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional.

Diferenciais
  • Experiência em psiquiatria da infância e adolescência;
  • Conhecimentos em psicofarmacologia e neurociência;
  • Formação complementar em psicoterapia;
  • Fluência em outros idiomas;
  • Disponibilidade para educação continuada.
Modelo de atuação
  • Atendimento 100% online;
  • Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica;
  • Flexibilidade de agenda;
  • Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas;
  • Parte do valor da consulta destinada à clínica e parte repassada ao profissional.

A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico:

  • Mantenha disponibilidade regular no WhatsApp para comunicação com a equipe da clínica;
  • Acompanhe frequentemente a plataforma e o site para verificar consultas agendadas;
  • Responda aos chamados administrativos e assistenciais dentro de prazo razoável;
  • Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento.
O que esperamos do profissional

Mais do que títulos e currículo, buscamos médicos comprometidos com:

  • Responsabilidade profissional;
  • Pontualidade e organização;
  • Cumprimento rigoroso das agendas;
  • Respeito aos pacientes;
  • Ética e humanização no atendimento;
  • Continuidade e qualidade assistencial.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Evaluation Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


As part of your application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

  • Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), se inscreve para estudar alemão por até 2 anos na maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, até atingir o nível B2 (final do intermediário). Quem é a Sprache&Wissen?

  • A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, com a meta de capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.


Principais atividades (na Alemanha):

  • Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico
  • Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos
  • Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão
  • Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador


Requisitos:

  • Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil
  • Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão)
  • Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários
  • Comprometimento com a carga horária do curso e as etapas do programa
  • Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir)


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível)
  • Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico
  • Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado


Sobre o período de estudos (home office):

  • O curso de alemão é 100% online — você estuda do Brasil enquanto se prepara
  • Mentoria gratuita em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2
  • Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual


Etapas do processo:

  • Inscrição e triagem inicial
  • Entrevista com o time da S&W
  • Aprovação de ficha e documentações
  • Assinatura do contrato com garantia de emprego
  • Matrícula no curso de alemão (até o nível B2)
  • Match com recrutador alemão
  • Colocação profissional na Alemanha

title: Bilingual English Teacher - Remote Role [T]
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bilingual English Teacher - Remote Role [T] em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Role Overview

We are currently inviting qualified ESL teachers to apply for a remote instructional role supporting international learners through our structured online teaching platform.

This is a contract-based teaching position offering self-managed scheduling within a professional global education environment.


Why Join Us

·      Remote teaching structure

·      Self-managed scheduling

·      Access to professional development opportunities

·      Supportive global educator network

·      Dedicated online teaching portal


Core Requirements

·      Bachelor’s Degree or higher

·      Recognized English teaching certification (TESOL / TEFL / TESL – CELTA or equivalent preferred)

·      Minimum of 2 years ESL teaching experience

·      Demonstrated commitment to professional growth and teaching excellence


Professional Qualifications (Preferred)

·      Advanced ESL qualifications (Level 5 equivalent or higher such as CELTA, TKT, DipTESOL, PGCE, MEd, PhDEd)

·      Continuous professional development (CPD) participation

·      Experience with international learners


Language Capability Requirements

·      English proficiency at CEFR C2 (or equivalent) is required

·      Proficiency in at least one additional language at CEFR B1+ or higher is strongly preferred

﻿Teaching Scope

You may support either young learners or adult learners depending on teaching allocation.

Students may include:

• School-aged learners

• University students

• Working professionals

• Adult learners seeking conversational fluency

All curriculum materials are provided and accessible in advance of teaching sessions.

Next Step
  • Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume for review.

title: Region/Country Tire Sales Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Region/Country Tire Sales Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Region/Country Tire Sales Manager

Location: South America Region

Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Tire Sales Manager with a strong background in selling semi-steel products. The ideal candidate will have significant experience in managing or working with retail tire stores and will be responsible for expanding our presence in this sector, driving sales growth, and building long-term relationships with clients.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and execute sales strategies to promote and sell Passenger Car Radial(PCR) tire products, including all Channels,especially retail stores in the region/country .

- Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the region/country, expanding our client base and opening new accounts.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with retail store managers, owners, and other stakeholders to maximize sales opportunities.

- Provide detailed product knowledge to customers and assist them in making informed purchasing decisions.

- Monitor market trends and competitor activities to stay ahead of industry developments and adapt sales strategies accordingly.

- Collaborate with the marketing and product teams to ensure that our products meet customer needs and that promotional efforts are aligned with sales objectives.

- Achieve sales targets and regularly report on performance metrics to management.

Qualifications:

- A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in tire sales, with a focus on Passenger Car Radial(PCR) tire products.

- Strong experience in retail store management or sales within the tire industry.

- Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and developing long-term client relationships.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

-Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and prioritize tasks.

- Knowledge of the tire industry and market trends is essential.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Previous experience in opening new retail accounts and developing retail store networks.

- Familiarity with market dynamics and customer needs in the Passenger Car Radial(PCR) tire segment.

description:
